svg.aria-label: Ogmios: your voice flows in from the left as a sound wave, the verbs of your book (tumbled, gave up, curtseyed) flow in from the right, and both meet in the Ogmios orb. Speak with Claude. Learn the verbs of your book.
svg.text: Speak with Claude. Learn the verbs of your book.
Both flow into the same place: your English.
nobody corrects you mid-sentence · each verb comes with the book’s own sentence
